Naha,

lead singer of the idol group 
Super Monkey's in 1992 when she was 14 years old. Despite early sales disappointments, Amuro's rising popularity helped to score a major hit with the 1995 
Eurobeat single "
Try Me (Watashi o Shinjite)".
[9][10][11] Signing to 
Avex Trax for her solo career, Amuro catapulted to fame with a string of number one singles including "

dance-pop sound with Western influences. Her first four releases, including 
Sweet 19 Blues (1996) and

Can You Celebrate?" remains as the best selling single by a solo female artist in Japanese music history.
